description: Recent news items about Proof of Work mining and network events, optionally filtered to one coin. Items are aggregated from third-party feeds and are returned as quoted external content with their publisher and a relevance score, not as BackPow statements of fact. Use when a question turns on recent events — a halving, a difficulty swing, a pool outage, a chain upgrade. For numbers rather than narrative, use get_coin_oracle or get_cost_of_production.

include_low_signal.description: Include items that relevance triage scored 0. Excluded by default so results stay on topic for Proof of Work mining.

name: get_pow_news
title: PoW mining news
